test_title: PYST 46: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 31 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Choose the option that can substitute the underlined segment correctly and complete the meaning of the sentence.**

Meenakshi looks **__very beautiful__** in her blue dress.
solution: The correct answer is **"Gorgeous."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Gorgeous"** means extremely beautiful and attractive. (अत्‍यंत प्रीतिकर या आकर्षक, भव्‍य, शानदार) • **Example**: *You look **gorgeous**__ in that dress.* • It is a suitable substitute for **"very beautiful"** in the given sentence. • The correct answer is option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, "Admiring"**, means expressing praise or approval. (प्रशंसा का भाव रखना या उसे अभिव्‍यक्त करना) • **Option 2, "Lavish"**, means extravagant or luxurious. (जो बहुत पैसा दे या ख़र्च करे, ख़र्चीला; फिज़ूलख़र्ची) • **Option 4, "Lively"**, means full of energy and excitement. (चुस्‍ती, रुचि, रोमांच आदि से भरपूर; जानदार, ज़िंदादिल) 39:Td4c, The correct answer is **"through his exaggerated descriptions."**
